documents.title: Bambu PLA Marble Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Marble Safety Data Sheet (SDS20251127A07)
Bambu PLA Marble Hex Code Table
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS and build plate compatibility

notes: TDS rows with no registry key (recorded, not stored): Young's Modulus (X-Y) 2330 ± 240 MPa and (Z) 1970 ± 210 MPa (ISO 527, GB/T 1040); Melt Index 32.2 ± 4.5 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Crystallization Temperature "/" (not given); Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.44% (25 °C, 55% RH); Printing and Storage Humidity < 20% RH (sealed with desiccant); Bed Surface Preparation Glue; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Max Overhang Angle 55°; Max Bridging Length 30 mm; Support Material Support for PLA; suggested annealing 50 to 60 °C for 6 to 12 hours.

TDS p.3 qualitative properties: Odorless; Skin Hazards No hazard; Insoluble in water; not resistant to acid or alkali; not resistant to some organic solvents; resistant to most kinds of oil and grease; Flammable; combustion products water and carbon oxides.
SDS: not classified under (EC) No 1272/2008; not hazardous goods for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO/IATA transport; section 9 gives no numeric physical property ("No data available").

Mechanical values are printed-specimen results (TDS Specimen Test: printed and annealed specimens); density, melting and glass transition are material properties (ISO 1183, DSC). No raw-material (injection-moulded) mechanical values are published, so no key mixes the two.

Wiki inconsistency for adjudication: the material table marks PLA Marble hardened steel nozzle "Not Required" and 0.4/0.6/0.8 mm nozzles Compatible, while the text below it lists PLA Marble among particle-filled filaments with "Always use a hardened steel nozzle" and "Do not use a stainless steel or brass nozzle", and highly recommends a 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle for Bambu PLA Marble. The PLA Usage Guide says "All standard nozzles are acceptable (excluding 0.2 mm nozzle)". No requires or not_compatible_with relation is recorded for nozzle material.

The store page RoHS document (https://store.bblcdn.com/1ff1a5ed13714099903ea56349d9a65f.pdf, "Filament RoHS") was not in the offline cache and was not read, so safety.certifications is neither stored nor listed as not_published.
